main.content:
==English==

===Etymology===
{{PIE word|en|tréyes}}
From {{uder|en|la|distributus}}, past participle of {{m|la|[[distribuo|distribuere]]||to divide, distribute}}, from {{m|la|dis-||apart}} + {{m|la|[[tribuo|tribuere]]||to give, impart}}; see [[tribute]].

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/dɪˈstɹɪbjuːt/|/ˈdɪstɹɪbjuːt/|a=RP}}
* {{enPR|dĭ-strĭbʹyo͞ot|a=GA,CA}}, {{IPA|en|/dɪˈstɹɪbjut/}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-distribute.ogg|a=California}}
* {{IPA|en|/dɪˈstɹɪbjʉːt/|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/dəˈstɹəbjʉːt/|a=NZ}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪbjuːt|ɪstɹɪbjuːt|s=3}}
* {{hyphenation|en|dis|trib|ute}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{senseid|en|to divide into portions and dispense}}{{lb|en|transitive}} To [[divide]] into [[portion]]s and [[dispense]].
#: {{ux|en|He '''distributed''' the bread amongst his followers.}}
# {{senseid|en|to supply to retail outlets}}{{lb|en|transitive}} To [[supply]] to [[retail]] outlets.
#: {{ux|en|The agency '''distributes''' newspapers to local shops.}}
# {{senseid|en|to deliver or pass out}}{{lb|en|transitive}} To [[deliver]] or [[pass out]].
#: {{ux|en|A network of children '''distributes''' flyers to every house.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2000|author=George Abe|title=Residential Broadband|publisher=Cisco Systems|isbn=1578701775
|passage=Datacasting bypasses the wired, terrestrial Internet and is a cheaper way to  '''distribute''' software than pressing and mailing CDs.}}
# {{senseid|en|to scatter or spread}}{{lb|en|transitive}} To [[scatter]] or [[spread]].
#: {{ux|en|I raked the soil then '''distributed''' grass seed.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1949|title=Proceedings of the ... Consolidated Convention of the International Brotherhood of Boiler Makers, Iron Ship Builders, and Helpers of America|page=159
|passage=The air-handling equipment humidifies, dehumidifies, and '''distributes''' the correct amount of fresh air into every zone and eliminates all smoke, dust, and odors, with electric precipitrons.}}
# {{senseid|en|to apportion}}{{lb|en|transitive}} To [[apportion]] (more or less [[evenly]]).
#: {{ux|en|The robot's six legs '''distributed''' its weight over a wide area.}}
# {{senseid|en|to classify or separate into categories}}{{lb|en|transitive}} To [[classify]] or [[separate]] into [[categories]].
#: {{ux|en|The database '''distributed''' verbs into transitive and intransitive segments.}}
# {{senseid|en|to be distributive}}{{lb|en|intransitive|mathematics}} To be [[distributive]].
#: {{ux|en|Multiplication '''distributes''' over addition.}}
# {{lb|en|printing}} To separate ([[type]] which has been used) and return it to the proper boxes in the [[case]]s.
# {{lb|en|printing}} To spread (ink) evenly, as upon a [[roller]] or a [[table]].
# {{lb|en|logic}} To employ (a term) in its whole extent; to take as universal in one premise.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1826|author=w:Richard Whately|title=Elements of Logic
|passage=A term is said to be '''distributed''' when it is taken universal, so as to stand for everything it is capable of being applied to.}}
# {{lb|en|business}} To have employees working remotely from multiple locations.
#: {{ux|en|'''distributed''' business; '''distributed''' employee}}

====Conjugation====
{{en-conj|distribute|stem=distribut|old=1}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|to divide into portions and dispense}} {{l|en|allot}}, {{l|en|dispend}}, {{l|en|parcel out}}; see also [[Thesaurus:distribute]]
* {{sense|to deliver or pass out}} {{l|en|courier}}
* {{sense|to scatter or spread}} {{l|en|disperse}}, {{l|en|sparble}}, {{l|en|strew}}; see also [[Thesaurus:disperse]]
* {{sense|to classify or separate into categories}} {{l|en|categorize}}, {{l|en|sort}}; see also [[Thesaurus:classify]]
